# Bid the floor, the stairs, and the extras.

> Price a carpet install from floor yards, stairs, stretch-in versus glue-down versus carpet tile, patterned waste, and extras — plus the walk-away price a $2-a-yard special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
